-- Final comprehensive query with proper casting
WITH player_match_runs AS (
  SELECT bbs.striker as player_id, bbs.match_id, CAST(SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS INTEGER) as match_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bbs
  JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON bbs.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bbs.striker, bbs.match_id
),
total_runs AS (
  SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) as total_runs
  FROM player_match_runs
  GROUP BY player_id
),
balls_faced AS (
  SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls
  FROM ball_by_ball
  GROUP BY striker
),
dismissals AS (
  SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
  FROM wicket_taken
  GROUP BY player_out
),
highest_score AS (
  SELECT player_id, MAX(match_runs) as highest_score
  FROM player_match_runs
  GROUP BY player_id
),
matches_30 AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as matches_30
  FROM player_match_runs
  WHERE match_runs >= 30
  GROUP BY player_id
),
matches_50 AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as matches_50
  FROM player_match_runs
  WHERE match_runs >= 50
  GROUP BY player_id
),
matches_100 AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as matches_100
  FROM player_match_runs
  WHERE match_runs >= 100
  GROUP BY player_id
),
matches_played AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as total_matches
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY player_id
),
role_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as role_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, role) as rn
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
  FROM role_counts
  WHERE rn = 1
),
bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT bbs.bowler as player_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wt.player_out IS NOT NULL) as total_wickets,
         SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs_conceded,
         COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
  FROM ball_by_ball bbs
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON bbs.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
    ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = er.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt 
    ON bbs.match_id = wt.match_id AND bbs.over_id = wt.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = wt.innings_no
  WHERE bbs.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bbs.bowler
),
bowling_per_match AS (
  SELECT bbs.bowler as player_id, bbs.match_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wt.player_out IS NOT NULL) as wickets,
         CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
  FROM ball_by_ball bbs
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON bbs.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
    ON bbs.match_id = er.match_id AND bbs.over_id = er.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = er.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt 
    ON bbs.match_id = wt.match_id AND bbs.over_id = wt.over_id 
    AND bbs.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = wt.innings_no
  WHERE bbs.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bbs.bowler, bbs.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
  SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_conceded,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC) as rn
  FROM bowling_per_match
)
SELECT 
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  mfr.most_frequent_role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  CAST(COALESCE(tr.total_runs, 0) AS INTEGER) as total_runs,
  COALESCE(mp.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
  COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * tr.total_runs / d.total_dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
  COALESCE(hs.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
  COALESCE(m30.matches_30, 0) as matches_30,
  COALESCE(m50.matches_50, 0) as matches_50,
  COALESCE(m100.matches_100, 0) as matches_100,
  COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) as total_balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * tr.total_runs / bf.total_balls * 100 ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
  COALESCE(bs_stats.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs_stats.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * bs_stats.total_runs_conceded / (bs_stats.total_balls_bowled / 6.0) ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
  CASE WHEN bb.rn = 1 THEN CAST(bb.wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(bb.runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN total_runs tr ON p.player_id = tr.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON p.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_30 m30 ON p.player_id = m30.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_50 m50 ON p.player_id = m50.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_100 m100 ON p.player_id = m100.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bs_stats ON p.player_id = bs_stats.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id AND bb.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
